chapters: Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu i'ii'ñ gu mar gu Kusi gu mar gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Amariias gu mar gu Esekîas gu tanoolh gu Josiiyas gu mar gu Amoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx tu'x bhaan gu vupui gu oidha' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ gu vaakax; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr gu vatop gu gɨ' suudai' gu jodai gu chuukug bɨɨx jix bhai'x; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ bhaan gu vupui gu oidha' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu novɨ bhaan gu Judaa bhaan bɨx jix koi gu Jerusalem gu suudai' dhi' pai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Baal gu tɨɨgɨ' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug bhaan gu jodai' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu ux gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu ux gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' tɨkka gu ux.
Na gu' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios na gu' gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios mia'n; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu suudai' gu maa'nkar gu chuukug tu' koi'cham.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' bhaan chiñia' bhaan gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' bhaan bɨx gu oi'ñga'n tɨi'chu' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bhaan bɨx gu suudai' ki'ñgob gu takarui' gu ux iatda' gu vaak gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook dɨr ki'ñgob gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug dɨr gookim jix gɨ' gu jodai' dɨr gu ja'tkam.
Na gu' jix duñia' jix koi gu vaak na gu' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu chuukug gu jodai'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu bhóogɨt tuumiñ.

Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' kutun kavɨk gu Jerusalem bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' bhaan gu chichio'ñ gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ux gu jodai' gu takarui' gu i'ii'ñ gu vaak gu chuukug; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu' cham jix daa; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook oidha' u'va gu' cham i'i suudai' u'va.
Jano' ba' mia'n gu tanoolh jix gɨ' gu Jawatan Dios mia'n gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh daak mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu chuukug gu ux gu tanoolh gu jodai' na jix uam gu bhóogɨt gu tanoolh gu tukgam gu tanoolh gu takarui' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk gu suudai' bhaan jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk bhaan gu oi'ñga'n gɨ' vaak.
Na gu' gu o'o gu chichio'ñ jiim na ja'p ñiññia na gu' jix duñia' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ɨ'ɨr ka't gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p oo' gu chuukug na ja'p gu kutun.

Jano' ba' tu' jix toja jodai tu' jix uam jodai gu kutun jix duñia' gu tanoolh daak gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' bɨx gu oidha' ka't gu suudai' bɨɨx gu tai gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ux jix duñia' bɨɨx bɨx jix koi gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug jix duñia' gu ja'tkam cham jix bhai'x.

Jano' ba' va'k gu bhóogɨt gu duukam gu tanoolh gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' va'k gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu ñi'ook i'iich gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios va'k gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu suudai' gu oidha' jix dhaas jix duñia' ñi'ook na jir bhai'; gio ba' gu suudai' bɨx bhai' gu suudai' gu vaak; mi' dhɨr gu kutun ka't nukadham gu tanoolh gu duukam gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' gu Gasa ka't gu suudai' gu Askaloon gu takarui'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Asdod tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh gu Ekroon ka't jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix koi baasɨ'n gu gɨ' suudai' gu ja'tkam gu Keretim gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Kanaan gu oidha' gu ñi'ook tu' gu bhóogɨt cham tu' duu bɨɨx ka'm cham gu bhóogɨt jix koi.
Jano' ba' ka't baasɨ'n gu gɨ' suudai' gu ux gu vaak na jix bhai' gu suudai' bipia'dam gu bhóogɨt kakneer.
Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr baasɨ'n na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu Judaa; gio ba' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu vaak gu Askaloon jix koox gu tukaa'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' naak gu ja'tkam gu Moab gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon bɨɨx jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook.

Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu Moab ka't na ja'p gu Sodoma gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon na ja'p gu Gomorra; gio ba' yooxi' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' dhi' ɨlhdham gu ux na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jawatan Dios bhaan na gu' jix duñia' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha'; gio ba' maa'n dɨr pai' jix duñia' bɨx gu chuukug chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gio gu jodai' ka't koko'kam bɨɨx gu kuchii.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ bhaan gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu Assur gu bhóogɨt gu Niinibe gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' na ja'p oidha' jix gaki.

Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaakax jix duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu vaakax chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' gu chuukug gio gu oi'ñga'n jix koox gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu bhóogɨt ka't kiki'ñgob na gu' gu chuukug gɨ' u'u kavɨk ka't jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' dhi' kiicham jix bhai'x ka't gu takarui' chɨtda gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' tu' cham gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu vaakax no'x gu oi'ñga'n ju'ñdharan jix duñia' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook kiicham gu takarui' jix duñia' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia'; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' chiñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt sɨsɨɨ' gu xumai cham mi'x dhaas o'o na ba' gu xibh.
Jano' ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu suudai' gu chichio'ñ gu jodai'; gio ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' xidhuu jix duñia' ñi'ook na tu a'ga.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jir bhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham jix duñia' tu' na cham jir bhai'; gio ba' gu xibh jix duñia' gu tasi' ñi'ook na jir bhai' cham pai' dhuuk uañi'ñ; gu' jix bhai'x cham juraa'n xi'ɨraam.

Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n oidha' jix gaki gu vaak bɨɨx ka'm cham gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n; jano' ba' jɨ'dɨlh gu chuukug bɨɨx ka'm cham gu bhóogɨt gu chio'ñ bɨɨx ka'm cham gu bhóogɨt jix koi.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jum i'obh makia' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr cham ka't ba'bhak gu bhóogɨt gu ux bɨx mii' dhɨr bhaan gu suudai'; gu' jix búup gu xibh jix duñia' bɨx buimɨi.

Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui'; na gu' gu ñi'ook chɨbɨɨp gu oi'ñga'n oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' na ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu duukam bɨx i'iich gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu tai gu ñi'ook ka't gu suudai' bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ux jano' ba' gu jodai' tu' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' na ba' bɨx gu takarui' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix duu gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n baasɨ'n gu jodai' gu suudai' mar u'vɨ gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu maa'nkar.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh cham ka' jum xibhɨ'ñ gu ux matgɨm buimɨi bɨɨx tu' gu bhóogɨt bhaan tu'; na gu' jano' ba' gu jodai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu jodai' gu ux cham pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu suudai' gu kavɨk jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' mi'x dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ja'tkam gu i'ii'ñ gampai' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel cham jix duñia' tu' na cham jir bhai' tu' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook tu' gu chin gu ñi'ook nɨɨn jix bhai'x; na gu' ka't gu oi'ñga'n jix koox cham gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu Sioon; gio ba' jix maa jiiñak gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n jix suudai' duu bɨx gu i'ii'ñ mar u'vɨ gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu vaak ñi'ook na jir bhai' tu' baas mai' obhɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; mi' dhɨr cham pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu Jerusalem; gio ba' cham jum i'obh; mi' dhɨr gu Sioon cham gu ñi'ook gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook u'ua'tɨda'; gio ba' jix duñia' bhaan tu' bɨɨx gu kutun gu chuukug xoi'kam jix duñia' bhaan tu' bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ux kuiñcha jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu jodai' jix bɨɨx duu; na ba' gu jodai' ka't gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' gu takarui' bɨx gu jodai'; gio ba' dodhia' gu takarui' gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu kutun gu ux gu ñi'ook bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' na jix uam.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' gu jodai' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n tu'; na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu ux gu kutun tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' na pai' dhuuk gu jodai' gu i'ii'ñ vupui bhaan gu vupui tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
